intro: An enclosed fiber laser cuts inside a laser-safe cabin with fume extraction, and its exchange table or pallet changer loads the next sheet while the first is being cut — the production laser that keeps cutting while the operator unloads, and the kind most shops buy from 5 × 10 ft up. NovoTech sells two lines in Canada, both on this page: the premium Dener lasers made in Turkey — the GFL with a space-frame gantry rated for 1.5 G and a pallet changer in 5 × 10 to 6.6 × 20 ft, 3 to 40 kW, and the Smart closed-type with a double exchange table in six sizes to 8.5 × 41 ft; and the value line — NovoTech's own ULE with a 15-second exchange table to 41 ft, the H series with pallet changer from 5 × 10 to 8.3 × 40 ft and 1.5 to 80 kW, and compact enclosed lasers of 4 × 4 and 5 × 10 ft from 1.5 kW. Every model is in the table below with its working area, power and speed, then each family with its full specification, photos and brochure. Every machine comes with a CSA-approved panel, chiller and nesting software, installed, trained and supported from Mississauga, ON, Canada. For a single-table machine at a lower price see the open-type lasers; for heavy plate the plate lasers.

faq.q: Exchange table or pallet changer — what is the difference?
faq.a: Both load the next sheet while the first is cut. An exchange table (Smart closed-type, ULE, compact) has two tables that swap places in 15 – 25 seconds, one in the cabin cutting and one outside being loaded. A pallet changer (GFL, H series) lifts the pallet with the cut sheet out of the cabin and slides the loaded pallet in, which is the arrangement a loading tower and sheet storage connect to for lights-out production. For a few sheets an hour the exchange table is enough; for automation, the pallet changer.

The premium GFL and Smart closed-type are built by Dener in Turkey on stress-relieved frames — the GFL rated for 1.5 G — with Precitec heads, IPG / nLIGHT sources, longer life at high duty and Dener Canada parts in Mississauga, ON, Canada: the machines for two shifts a day. NovoTech's value-line ULE, the H series and the compact lasers are built in China with their own or Raycus sources in a wider range — 4 × 4 ft machines, 60 – 80 kW — at a lower price; NovoTech stocks the parts and does the service. Same cut quality at the same power.

faq.q: What laser power do I need?
faq.a: Power sets the thickness and the speed. As a guide for mild steel: 3 kW cuts 1/2″, 6 kW 3/4″ (and 1/4″ at over 300 in/min), 12 kW 1″, 20 kW 1-1/4″ and 30 – 40 kW 1-1/2″ and beyond; stainless and aluminum run about 20 – 30 % thinner at the same power, with nitrogen or air assist. Most Canadian job shops buying today choose 6 or 12 kW: thick enough for structural work, fast enough to pay for the machine on thin sheet. Tell us your material mix and we run the cutting chart for you.

The model number is the nominal working area in centimetres: 3015 = 10 × 5 ft (3,000 × 1,500 mm) — a standard 4 × 8 or 5 × 10 sheet; 4020 = 13 × 6.6 ft; 6020 = 20 × 6.6 ft for 6 × 20 plate; 6025 and 8025 = 20 and 26 ft × 8.2 ft; 12526 = 41 × 8.5 ft. The 5 × 10 machine is the Canadian standard; buy the 6020 if you cut 20 ft plate or want to nest several sheets without reloading; the 4 × 4 ft Senfeng compact is for small parts in a small shop.

Yes — a loading / unloading tower that feeds the pallet changer, sheet storage with several shelves for lights-out production, part sorting, and bevel heads for weld preparation. The Dener GFL and closed-type Smart, the NovoTech ULE and the Senfeng H series are prepared for the tower; the Senfeng coil-fed lines go further and cut straight from the coil. Ask us for the automation layout.

faq.q: What about assist gas and fume extraction?
faq.a: Oxygen gives the fastest cut and an oxide edge on mild steel; nitrogen a clean, paint-ready edge on all metals; compressed air at 16 bar replaces nitrogen on sheet to about 1/4″ and cuts the gas bill to near zero — the intelligent air-cutting package is an option on both lines. The machines have pneumatic extraction compartments under the table and connect to a dust collector, which we can supply.

faq.q: What is in a Dener laser as standard?
faq.a: An IPG, Raycus or nLIGHT fiber source, a Precitec or Raytools autofocus cutting head with capacitive height sensing and collision protection, a stress-relieved welded frame, pneumatic fume-extraction compartments under the table and scrap boxes on wheels, a chiller, a CNC with nesting software, cutting database and production reports, and a remote handset. Cutting gas regulators, dust collector connections and the CSA-approved panel with a 600 V transformer are included in the NovoTech package.

faq.q: What does the machine need on site?
faq.a: A level floor, 600 V 3-phase (with the transformer we supply) or 480 V, a chiller (included), assist gas, a dust collector and a compressed-air supply for air cutting. A 6 kW 3015 draws about 30 kW in total and needs roughly 33 × 20 ft with a pallet changer. Delivery, installation and operator training are done by NovoTech from Mississauga, ON, Canada, and the Ontario pre-start health and safety review is prepared by us.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models whose main motor is 2.2 kW (3 HP) or less — a machine with a motor above 2.2 kW must run on three-phase power and cannot be converted to 240 V single-phase. Manual machines have no electrics.
